build_trie_math_tokens: build a trie from math token to id mapping for greedy longest-match encoding
create_token_regex: create a regex pattern from a list of tokens sorted longest-first for greedy matching
encode_greedy_math: encode a math string using greedy longest-match against a trie of LaTeX math tokens
decode_token_ids: decode a list of absolute token ids back to text with latex escape fixup
tokenize_ocr_text: tokenize ocr text with tasks and return input ids using the surya ocr tokenizer
